channel.outerProcNote: non-gating: the driver reads /proc/<pid> in ITS OWN PID namespace. The shell's `$$` is namespace-local on this World (the host runs inside the platform sandbox), so this field is recorded to SHOW the namespace boundary, not to prove or disprove the PTY.

whyThisService: the composed profile for this World declares exactly one `bash` tool row: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash-persistent, inside the preset group that also mounts @deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal and @deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash (composed-profile.patch.yml)
the tool row cannot obtain a PTY from anywhere else: its only PTY seam is inject ['tools','terminals']
the shell's OWN /proc/$$/stat reports a controlling terminal whose tty_nr major is 136 (the Linux pts major) and a positive session id, and /proc/$$/fd/0 resolves to a /dev/pts/N slave
the confined subprocess provider (the realm's other process face) recorded NO spawn attempt for the bash command, so the shell did not come from the confined face
the governed realm's own compiled answer for this Member records realmFaces=[subprocess] and hasTerminalsFace=false, so no realm installed a terminal

serviceWitness.note: the PTY service itself, asked on the SAME owner handle the `bash` tool used; mounted inside the same preset group so it observes the SAME isolated `terminals` instance

attribution.serviceWitnessProves: the isolated `terminals` instance the preset group owns registered the `shell` backend type and held exactly one owner-scoped session for this Member, whose snapshot names the session id, type and pid — i.e. the SERVICE that served the call, not an inference from the profile

governedRealmAnswer.note: the governed realm answer for this Member; no terminal face exists in RealmServiceFaces (PD-3), so this list is the whole confined surface

locus.layer: Product preset (inherited legacy-generation PTY), NOT a governed realm face
locus.detail: request -> tool route -> agent tools -> @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash-persistent -> ctx.terminals -> TerminalSessionService -> @deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash -> node-pty -> /dev/pts/N
locus.notTheConfinedFace: zero confined-spawn-attempt rows carry the bash command
